title.narrative: Exploring Africa’s Waste Management & Circular Economy for the Green Transition
Exploring Africa’s Waste Management & Circular Economy for the Green Transition

description.narrative: Bidraget fokuserar på Afrikas avfallshantering och cirkulära ekonomilandskap med ingångspunkter för den gröna omställningen
The contribution focuses on Africa’s waste management and circular economy landscape with entry points for the green transition

Study on exploring Africas (Tanzania, Zambia and Mozambique) Waste Management and Circular Economy Landscape: Pathways for the Green Transition and Opportunities for Swedish Companies.
The objectives of the study include to: - (i) Provide relevant information on the potential areas for development cooperation with linkages to the local and Swedish private sector in advancing just green transition pathways and waste management. (ii) To assess Africas waste management and circular economy landscape and identify entry points and opportunities for Swedish companies in supporting and benefiting from the just green transition.
The specific objectives of the study include to: - a) Map the current waste management systems, challenges, and policy frameworks in three (3) selected African countries: Tanzania, Zambia and Mozambique. b) Identify leading circular economy initiatives, trends, and partnerships on the continent. c) Analyse the regulatory, financial, and technological environments relevant to circular economy development. d) Identify sectors, with the highest potential for Swedish investment, innovation, and partnerships. e) Provide recommendations for Swedish stakeholders on strategic engagement and collaboration.
